Command: Seek the place God chooses and bring offerings there
Summary: The command: Seek the place God chooses and bring offerings there (Deuteronomy 12:5). Israel was to seek the place where the LORD put his name and bring all offerings there, rather than worshipping on every high hill.
Commandment: Seek the place God chooses and bring offerings there, as prescribed in Deuteronomy 12:5.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: Scripture's stated ground: the LORD chose one place to put his name, and there Israel was to bring all offerings (Deuteronomy 12:5-6).
